automatyka.title: Step {nr} of {z}: Automation

data.wstecz: Go back to the previous step

data_description.f_harmonogram: Opens in the morning and closes in the evening: at fixed times or with sunrise and sunset.
data_description.f_slonce: Lowers the shade when the sun shines into this window and it is warm.
data_description.f_blokada: Never lowers the shade onto an open or tilted window. A skipped move runs after the window closes.
data_description.f_wiatr: Retracts an outdoor shade in strong wind.
data_description.f_obecnosc: In the morning it stays closed until someone enters the room.
data_description.f_wakacje: Opens and closes at a slightly different time every day, as if someone were home.
data_description.f_licznik: Counts moves and run time, reminds you to calibrate.
data_description.f_reczny: When you move the shade with a remote or a button, the automation waits.
data_description.f_posrednia: At the chosen time the shade stops half way.
data_description.f_dni: Separate times at weekends and on holidays.
data_description.f_wietrzenie: With a tilted window the shade stays higher so air can flow.
data_description.f_drzwi: With the door open the shade goes no lower than the chosen position.
data_description.f_oslepianie: The shade goes down only so far that the sun reaches no further than the TV or desk.
data_description.f_zima: In winter it opens in the sun (free heat), in summer it shades.
data_description.f_jasnosc: A lux meter or solar panels decide about the sun.
data_description.f_temp_pokoj: Shades when the room gets too warm.
data_description.f_deszcz: Retracts the awning, screen and external venetian blind in the rain.
data_description.f_mroz: In frost the outdoor shade does not move, so it does not freeze.
data_description.f_grad: On a warning it retracts awnings and closes shutters to protect the glass.
data_description.f_drgania: Retracts the awning in a strong gust.
data_description.f_upal: When the forecast says heat, the shade goes down in the morning before the room warms up.
data_description.f_dym: On a smoke alarm it opens the shade – an escape route.
data_description.f_alarm: Closes the shade when the alarm is armed.
data_description.f_nikogo: Closes the shade when everyone leaves.
data_description.f_przeszkoda: Does not go down when the sensor sees something in the way.
data_description.f_spie: A switch on the device: the shade stays closed until you turn it off.
data_description.f_granice: The shade moves only within the chosen range, e.g. 10–90 %.
data_description.f_drobne: Skips changes of a few percent.
data_description.f_po_kolei: Shades in the house move a few seconds apart.
data_description.f_cisza: After HA starts the automation waits a few minutes.
data_description.f_proba: Shows what the automation would do, but does not move the shade.
data_description.wstecz: Turn on and click “Next” to go back one step. What you entered stays.

options.bateria: Low battery in the motor or sensor

options.ogolne_tryb: Not sure? Choose Basic. You can always change it.
options.ogolne_mam: Not sure whether you have something? Leave it as the wizard ticked it.
options.ogolne_kolory: The colour is only on screen, it changes nothing in the shade itself.
options.ogolne_okno: Two sashes with one shutter? Choose “Two sashes” and one motor.
options.ogolne_silnik: Leave 0 – the card measures the time by itself after a few moves.
options.ogolne_pogoda: A weather entity is enough. An anemometer gives more precise protection.
options.ogolne_automatyka: Start with one feature and see how it works. The “Reason” sensor shows why the shade moved.
options.ogolne_lamele: An angle of 45° lets light in, while the sun does not shine straight into the room.
options.ogolne_fotokomorka: No photocell in HA? The gate works the same, the card just does not know about the obstacle.
options.sypialnia_rodzaj: A blackout blind or a day-night blind is best for a bedroom. Morning light does not wake you.
options.sypialnia_automatyka: We recommend the schedule (sunrise in the morning, sunset in the evening) and the window lock if you sleep with the window tilted.
options.sypialnia_czujniki: In a bedroom the window is often tilted at night. Set “Tilts”.
options.salon_rodzaj: In a living room people usually choose day-night or pleated blinds – they let light in and block the view from the street.
options.salon_automatyka: We recommend sun protection. With a presence sensor the shade opens when someone comes in in the morning.
options.kuchnia_rodzaj: A cassette blind or an aluminium venetian blind suits a kitchen – easy to clean.
options.kuchnia_automatyka: We recommend the open window lock – the window is often open while cooking.
options.dziecko_rodzaj: A blackout blind is useful in a child's room for daytime naps.
options.dziecko_automatyka: We recommend the night schedule and the window lock.
options.gabinet_rodzaj: In an office a venetian blind or a screen reduces glare on the monitor.
options.gabinet_automatyka: We recommend glare protection – the shade goes down only as far as needed.
options.lazienka_rodzaj: For a bathroom choose a damp-proof shade: an aluminium venetian or a pleated blind.
options.lazienka_automatyka: We recommend the window lock – the window is often open after a bath.

confirm.title: Motor HA {wersja} – restart
confirm.description: The new version is installed. Click “Submit” to restart Home Assistant.

przeniesione.title: Motor HA 2.0 – windows moved
przeniesione.description: {ile} windows were moved from the previous version (Okno HA 1.x). They now work as new Motor HA devices with the same settings. The old entries are only disabled – you can delete them in Settings → Devices & services → Okno HA. Automation stays off until you turn it on in “Configure”.

wstrzymaj.name: Pause automation
wstrzymaj.description: The automation does not move the device for the given time (empty = until the end of the day).

minuty.name: Minutes
minuty.description: Empty = until the end of the day.

wznow.name: Resume automation
wznow.description: Ends the pause and checks right away where the shade should be.

przelicz.name: Check now
przelicz.description: The automation recalculates the position right away.

ustaw.name: Set position
ustaw.description: Sets the position (and slats) like the automation – without a manual-move pause.
